need: A revealed flashcard answer must contain meaningful answer content or an explicit access state, and recall grading must remain unavailable until meaningful answer content exists.
negativeBoundary: Do not render a label-only answer surface, silently treat withheld premium content as an empty answer, enable grading without answer evidence, or expose paid content to repair the presentation defect.
acceptanceCriteria: A non-empty answer body is visibly rendered whenever the answer state is available.
A withheld or blank answer renders an explicit unavailable message instead of an empty answer surface.
Recall grading controls are absent until a meaningful non-whitespace answer body is visible.
A newly created trial review draw excludes premium cards whose answers the learner cannot access.
UAT proves payload-to-DOM content completeness and entitlement variants, not only the existence of the answer surface.

accepts: A revealed answer includes visible semantic content before recall grading is offered.
rejects: A visible answer heading with an empty body while recall grading remains enabled.

review.rationale: Approved after payload-to-DOM tests and desktop/compact visual UAT proved an explicit unavailable-answer state and suppressed grading without meaningful answer content.
